introSubtitle: Chiang Mai Design Week AR Experience
introGuideStep1: Point your camera at the Lanna golden artwork markers
introGuideStep2: Watch the mystical hologram appear and dissolve into particles
introGuideStep3: Gather the floating light particles to uncover the character's story
scanInstruction: Point your camera at the target image
rotateDevice: Please rotate your device to portrait mode

target_0.name: Botan
target_0.title: Botan
target_0.concept: Inspired by Lanna botanical motifs simplified into a Chibi character, utilizing Pareidolia to transform golden floral patterns into a contemporary fairy guardian.
target_0.inspiration: Peony flower (wealth & nobility), Guardian Lion (courage & protection), and Lanna sacred gold patterns.
target_0.story: When daylight shines upon the ancient temple gold patterns, Botan awakens to protect Lanna cultural heritage and inspire modern creative minds.
target_0.colorMeaning:
• Red: Life energy & auspicious blessing
• Gold: Lanna sacred art & wisdom
• Pink: Gentleness & peony grace
• Pale Yellow: Light of nature & new beginnings

target_1.name: Ruangkham
target_1.title: Ruangkham
target_1.concept: A wildcat fairy guardian of seeds, fertility, and the growth of Lanna earth, derived from golden rice sheaf motifs.
target_1.inspiration: Flowering rice sheaf pattern, agile wildcat, and protective nature spirits.
target_1.story: Born under the full moon when moonlight hit golden rice patterns, Ruangkham spreads golden wings to revitalize crops and bless the land.
target_1.colorMeaning:
• Red: Vitality & courage
• Gold: Sacred abundance
• Emerald Green: Nature & hope

target_2.title: Phrukkham
target_2.concept: A botanical fairy born from the vitality of floral gold leaf motifs, guardian of seeds and blossoms.
target_2.inspiration: Lanna lotus and floral vine motifs, friendly nature spirit.
target_2.story: Phrukkham travels through forests, breathing golden light into dormant flora to restore vitality and joy.
target_2.colorMeaning:
• Emerald: Life force
• Gold: Cultural heritage
• Peach-Pink: Warmth & friendliness

target_3.colorMeaning:
• Gold: Sacred art
• Red: Life & bravery
